lines.port: // The Spanish game has no position table here: on its own card it centres the ID in an 88-pixel field from x 128
// (y 10); on the RSE one it prints it at (128, 9).
AddTextPrinterParameterized3(1, sTrainerCardFontIds[1], 128 + (88 - GetStringWidth(sTrainerCardFontIds[1], buffer, 0)) / 2, 10, sTrainerCardTextColors, TEXT_SKIP_DRAW, buffer);
